description: This dashboard shows how each node heard the node you select at the top. All stats are from the listed nodes and not from the node you select (how they heard you, not how you heard them).

targets.rawSql:
WITH NodeNames AS (
  SELECT REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS clean_id, MAX(long_name) AS long_name
  FROM node_details
  GROUP BY 1
),
GatewayHits AS (
  SELECT
    m.time,
    m.rx_snr AS "SNR",
    COALESCE(n.long_name, m.reporting_gateway::text) AS "Node"
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN NodeNames n ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = n.clean_id
  WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
    AND m.rx_snr IS NOT NULL
    AND (m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) = 0
    AND REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
),
NeighborHistory AS (
  SELECT
    nn.time,
    nn.snr AS "SNR",
    COALESCE(n.long_name, nn.node_id::text) AS "Node"
  FROM node_neighbors nn
  LEFT JOIN NodeNames n ON REPLACE(nn.node_id::text, '!', '') = n.clean_id
  WHERE REPLACE(nn.neighbor_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND nn.snr IS NOT NULL
    AND REPLACE(nn.node_id::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND $__timeFilter(nn.time)
),
TracerouteInitiator AS (
  SELECT
    m.time,
    m.snr_towards[1] / 4.0 AS "SNR",
    COALESCE(n.long_name, REPLACE(m.route_towards[1]::text, '!', '')) AS "Node"
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  LEFT JOIN NodeNames n ON REPLACE(m.route_towards[1]::text, '!', '') = n.clean_id
  WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
    AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'
    AND m.route_towards IS NOT NULL 
    AND array_length(m.route_towards, 1) > 0
    AND m.snr_towards[1] IS NOT NULL
    AND m.snr_towards[1] != -128
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
),
TracerouteRelay AS (
  SELECT
    m.time,
    m.snr_towards[(t.idx + 1)::int] / 4.0 AS "SNR",
    COALESCE(n.long_name, REPLACE(m.route_towards[(t.idx + 1)::int]::text, '!', '')) AS "Node"
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(m.route_towards) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(node_id, idx)
  LEFT JOIN NodeNames n ON REPLACE(m.route_towards[(t.idx + 1)::int]::text, '!', '') = n.clean_id
  WHERE m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'
    AND m.route_towards IS NOT NULL
    AND REPLACE(t.node_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND t.idx < array_length(m.route_towards, 1)
    AND m.snr_towards[(t.idx + 1)::int] IS NOT NULL
    AND m.snr_towards[(t.idx + 1)::int] != -128
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
)
SELECT * FROM GatewayHits
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM NeighborHistory
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM TracerouteInitiator
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM TracerouteRelay
ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: Rx SNR of direct gateways and outbound traceroutes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  -- The time the packet was first heard
  MIN(time) AS "time",
  
  -- A static name so all packets form a single series
  'Gateways Reached' AS "metric",
  
  -- Count how many distinct gateways heard this exact packet
  COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS "value"
  
FROM mesh_packet_metrics
WHERE source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
  AND reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
  
-- Grouping by the packet, NOT the gateway
GROUP BY COALESCE(packet_id::text, time::text)
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $__interval) AS "time",
  AVG(battery_level) AS "Battery %",
  AVG(channel_utilization) AS "Channel Util %"
FROM device_metrics
WHERE node_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
  AND battery_level IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

WITH RawSNR AS (
  -- Source 1: Direct Gateway Hits
  SELECT
    m.time,
    REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') AS receiver_id,
    m.rx_snr / 4.0 AS snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
    AND m.rx_snr IS NOT NULL
    AND (m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) = 0
    AND REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)

  UNION ALL

  -- Source 2: Traceroute First-Hops
  SELECT
    m.time,
    REPLACE(m.route_towards[1]::text, '!', '') AS receiver_id,
    m.snr_towards[1] / 4.0 AS snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
    AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'
    AND m.route_towards IS NOT NULL 
    AND array_length(m.route_towards, 1) > 0
    AND m.snr_towards[1] IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)

  UNION ALL

  -- Source 3: NeighborInfo "Gossip"
  SELECT
    m.time,
    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS receiver_id,
    val.snr / 4.0 AS snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(m.route_towards, m.snr_towards) AS val(heard_node, snr)
  WHERE m.portnum = 'NEIGHBORINFO_APP'
    AND REPLACE(val.heard_node::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND val.snr IS NOT NULL
    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
),
NodeNames AS (
  SELECT REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS clean_id, MAX(long_name) AS long_name
  FROM node_details
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
  -- 📍 Added the raw Node ID here
  r.receiver_id AS "Node ID",
  
  COALESCE(n.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || r.receiver_id || ')') AS "Receiver Node",
  COUNT(r.snr) AS "Samples",
  ROUND(MIN(r.snr)::numeric, 2) AS "Min SNR",
  ROUND(AVG(r.snr)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg SNR",
  ROUND(MAX(r.snr)::numeric, 2) AS "Max SNR"
FROM RawSNR r
LEFT JOIN NodeNames n ON r.receiver_id = n.clean_id

-- 🚫 THE BULLETPROOF GHOST FILTER 🚫
-- 1. Catch the raw hex IDs (handling case sensitivity)
WHERE LOWER(r.receiver_id) NOT IN ('ffffffff', '^all')
-- 2. Catch the resolved name from the database join
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(n.long_name, r.receiver_id)) NOT LIKE '%broadcast%'

-- 📍 Updated the GROUP BY to include both the ID and the Name
GROUP BY r.receiver_id, COALESCE(n.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || r.receiver_id || ')')
ORDER BY "Samples" DESC;

WITH GatewayNames AS (
  -- Get clean names without the '!'
  SELECT REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS clean_id, MAX(long_name) AS long_name
  FROM node_details
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(m.time, $__interval) AS "time",
  COALESCE(n.long_name, m.reporting_gateway::text) AS "metric",
  AVG(m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) AS "value"
FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN GatewayNames n ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = n.clean_id
WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
  AND m.reporting_gateway IS NOT NULL
  
  -- Prevent the node from showing up as its own gateway if it's connected to WiFi/Ethernet
  AND REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
  
  AND m.hop_start IS NOT NULL 
  AND m.hop_limit IS NOT NULL
  AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

targets.rawSql:
WITH RawSNR AS (
  -- Source 1: Direct Gateway Hits
  SELECT
    m.time,
    REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') AS receiver_id,
    m.rx_snr / 4.0 AS snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
    AND m.rx_snr IS NOT NULL
    AND (m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) = 0
    AND REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)

  UNION ALL

  -- Source 2: Traceroute First-Hops
  SELECT
    m.time,
    REPLACE(m.route_towards[1]::text, '!', '') AS receiver_id,
    m.snr_towards[1] / 4.0 AS snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  WHERE m.source_id::text IN (${node_id:singlequote})
    AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'
    AND m.route_towards IS NOT NULL 
    AND array_length(m.route_towards, 1) > 0
    AND m.snr_towards[1] IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)

  UNION ALL

  -- Source 3: NeighborInfo "Gossip"
  SELECT
    m.time,
    REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') AS receiver_id,
    val.snr / 4.0 AS snr
  FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(m.route_towards, m.snr_towards) AS val(heard_node, snr)
  WHERE m.portnum = 'NEIGHBORINFO_APP'
    AND REPLACE(val.heard_node::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND val.snr IS NOT NULL
    AND REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') != REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
    AND $__timeFilter(m.time)
),
ReceiverLocations AS (
  SELECT 
    REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') AS clean_id, 
    MAX(long_name) AS long_name,
    MAX(latitude) / 10000000.0 AS lat, 
    MAX(longitude) / 10000000.0 AS lon
  FROM node_details
  WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)

-- 1. THE RECEIVERS
SELECT
  l.lat AS latitude,
  l.lon AS longitude,
  COALESCE(l.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || r.receiver_id || ')') AS "Receiver",
  ROUND(AVG(r.snr)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg SNR",
  
  -- The New Columns
  r.receiver_id AS "Node ID",
  0 AS "Is Selected Node"

FROM RawSNR r
JOIN ReceiverLocations l ON r.receiver_id = l.clean_id
WHERE LOWER(r.receiver_id) NOT IN ('ffffffff', '^all')
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(l.long_name, r.receiver_id)) NOT LIKE '%broadcast%'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 5

UNION ALL

-- 2. THE INJECTED SOURCE NODE
SELECT
  MAX(latitude) / 10000000.0 AS latitude,
  MAX(longitude) / 10000000.0 AS longitude,
  COALESCE(MAX(long_name), 'Target Node') || ' (⭐ SOURCE)' AS "Receiver",
  99.9 AS "Avg SNR",
  
  -- The New Columns (Forcing a 1 and injecting the selected ID)
  REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '') AS "Node ID",
  20 AS "Is Selected Node"

FROM node_details
WHERE REPLACE(node_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(${node_id:singlequote}, '!', '')
  AND latitude IS NOT NULL
  AND longitude IS NOT NULL;
